title_html: TikTok Shop Seller Fees: What They Actually Cost at Scale
description: TikTok Shop charges a flat 6% referral fee, not a blended take rate. Here's what that fee covers, what it doesn't, and where the real cost of scale sits.
dek: Every brand vetting TikTok Shop asks some version of the same question: what's the real take rate? The honest answer is that the platform fee is smaller and simpler than most brands expect — and the number that actually determines your margin at scale isn't published anywhere.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Model what TikTok Shop actually costs for your brand.
llms_summary: TikTok Shop's platform fee is a flat 6% referral fee on most US categories (5% on select jewelry, 3% for new sellers' first 30 days), calculated as fee-rate times (customer payment plus platform discount minus tax), with a refund administration fee capped at $5 per SKU. Payment processing figures are inconsistently reported publicly and should be confirmed in Seller Center. The real cost of scale is affiliate commission and ad spend, both of which the brand controls, not TikTok.
